checks.name: optimistic-concurrency-mirrors-saverequirement
checks.summary: SaveRepository uses the same guard as SaveRequirement (internal/store/memory/store.go L236-245 in the base tree): a create must declare expected version 0, and any other save must declare the stored version exactly. Asserted: a create claiming expected version 3 is refused with domain.ErrStaleVersion; a create at 0 succeeds; a concurrent writer still believing the record is at version 0 is refused; a save at the stored version succeeds and the readback carries the new status and version.

checks.name: ordering-and-duplicate-key-visibility
checks.summary: Repositories() returns rows sorted by repository id, so the application's duplicate-locator scan is deterministic, and every row's normalised locator key is readable. The Observation is last-writer-wins by repository id, which is what makes a fresher measurement supersede an older one without a version negotiation.
